# qrcode-generator 2.0.4, vendored

`qrcode.mjs` is `dist/qrcode.mjs` from the npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4` (Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence, the
notice is at the top of the file), unchanged. SHA-256 `ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0`.

Used by `assets/vault-pane/inbox.js` to draw the link to a reader's inbox lane as a QR code, as SVG, in the browser
(card 049). Nothing is fetched from anywhere else.

The word "QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
